name: KPI Tiles
summary: Headline numbers with count-up animation, favourable/unfavourable delta and a sparkline.
summary_zh: 关键指标数字卡片：数字滚动动画、同比/环比变化（自动判断好坏方向）与迷你趋势线。
description_zh: 用于执行摘要页或每个章节开头，突出 4–6 个核心数字（营收、EBITDA 利润率、EV/EBITDA、净杠杆、股东回报等）。每行数据是一张卡片，可以单独为每张卡片设置格式码；good 字段决定涨跌哪个方向是“好”（如杠杆率下降是好），默认按好坏着色；红涨绿跌模式（updown="cn"）下按方向着色：上升一律为红色，下降一律为绿色。spark 字段是数字数组，绘制迷你趋势线。

spark.desc: Array of values for the sparkline

good.desc: 'up' or 'down' — which direction is favourable (colours the delta; in the cn up/down convention deltas are coloured by direction: rise red, fall green)

columns.desc: Fixed number of columns; null = balanced automatic count (as many as fit at ~160px, rows evened out: 6 tiles -> 6 x 1 wide, 3 x 2 at ~760px, 2 x 3 on phones)

countUp.desc: Animate numbers when they scroll into view
